questions.question: If a 3 -a 2 ≤ a 2 + a ≤ a 4 , then what is the value of a? यदि a 3 -a 2 ≤ a 2 + a ≤ a 4 है, तो a का मान कितना है?
questions.solution:
For a =0

0 ≤ 0≤0

So above given inequality is satisfied so a can be 0.

For a =2

(2)3- (2)2 ≤ (2)2 + 2 ≤ (2)4

So above given inequality is satisfied so a can be 2.

For a =-2

(-2)3- (-2)2 ≤ (-2)2 + (-2) ≤ (-2)4

So above given inequality is satisfied so a can be -2.

questions.question: If x 2 - 5 = 1/x 2 , then what is the value of (8x 6 - 8/x 6 )/32? यदि x 2 - 5 = 1/x 2 है, तो (8x 6 - 8/x 6 )/32 का मान कितना होगा?
questions.solution:
x2 - 5 = 1/x2

=> x2 - 1/x2 = 5 ----- (i)

Cubing both sides, we get

=> (x2 - 1/x2)3 = 53

=> (x2)3 - (1/x2)3 - 3 (x2)2/x2 + 3x2/(x2)2 = 125 ------ [(a - b)3 = a3 - b3 - 3a2b + 3ab2]

=> x6 - 1/x6 - 3x4/x2 + 3x2/x4 = 125

=> x6 - 1/x6 - 3x2 + 3/x2 = 125

=> x6 - 1/x6 - 3(x2 - 1/x2) = 125

=> x6 - 1/x6 - 3x5 = 125 [Putting the value of equation (i)]

=> x6 - 1/x6 - 15 = 125

=> x6 - 1/x6 = 125 + 15

=> x6 - 1/x6 = 140 ------- (ii)

Now,

(8x6 - 8/x6)/32

= 8/32 x (x6 - 1/x6)

= ¼ x (x6 - 1/x6)

= ¼ x 140 [Putting the value of equation(ii)]

= 35

questions.question: Solve the given expression - CotA * (1 - 4Sin 2 A)/(3 - 4Sin 2 A) दी गई अभिव्यक्ति को हल करें - CotA * (1 - 4Sin 2 A)/(3 - 4Sin 2 A)
questions.solution:
CotA * (1 - 4Sin2A)/(3 - 4Sin2A)

=> CosA/SinA * (1 - 4(1 - Cos2A))/(3 - 4Sin2A))

=> CosA/SinA * (1 - 4 + 4Cos2A)/(3 - 4Sin2A)

=> CosA/SinA * (4Cos2A - 3)/(3 - 4Sin2A)

=> (4Cos3A - 3CosA)/(3SinA - 4Sin3A)

=> Cos3A/Sin3A

=> Cot3A

questions.solution:
The concept of cyclicity is used to identify the last digit of the number.

Cyclicity chart:

(Note: remainder = power. When remainder is 0, power = cyclicity)

= (23 x 3 + 15 x 7)48

= (69 + 105)48

= 17448

In 17448:

Unit digit of 174 is 4.

448: From the cyclicity chart, cyclicity of 4 is 2.

48/2 remainder = 0 =power 2
